style: Theatrical avant-punk art-rock, high kinetic energy, driving pulse. Harmony: suspended quartal clusters, sliding subharmonic drones, unresolved upper partials, perpetual vertical tension. Melody: clipped phonetic patter, talk-box vocal-tract sweeps, vocoder formant shifts, rapid alveolar trills. Rhythm: complex 3:2 cross-rhythm coupling, double-time hallucination, asymmetric meter collisions. Timbre: magnetic tape loops with wow and degradation, optigan optical playback grains, physical-modeling strings, granular swarms, wavetable morphs, subtractive filter sweeps. Performance: breathless hype urgency paired with persistent bewilderment. Production: dry separation stemminess, cheap analog circuit saturation, spring recoil, high exposure windows, dynamic transient snaps, wide acoustic stage, resonant cabinet rattles, auxiliary feedback loops, direct input bite, microtonal detuning.
